method: Roslyn inventory over Compliance.Common and Compliance.Core. It recognizes explicit and target-typed DomainEvent construction that reaches RaiseEvent, AuditEvent, a typed raise callback, a publishing helper, or a returned event value raised by an owning aggregate caller; it also scans On<Fact> reducers, IRequest contracts, IRequestHandler implementations, AddRequestHandler registrations, typed aggregate mutation targets, and source-derived direct callers. Aggregate call reachability is a syntactic heuristic matched by method name and compatible arity; receiver and symbol identity are not resolved, so route rows are candidate evidence for human review rather than semantic proof. Legacy emitters remain listed with replay compatibility requirements until a verified stream migration. Test paths are navigation evidence, not proof of fact-specific replay or behavior assertions.
